entry.title: Antigravity CLI v1.5.8 — 32 placemat changes
entry.content:
• ADD /agy-customizations [request] (card-slash-tools) — new row: loads the customization reference so the agent can build or explain rules, skills, plugins, hooks, and MCP servers
  • ADD /antigravity-guide [question] (card-slash-tools) — new row: answers how to use or configure Antigravity from the official docs
  • ADD gateway.routeWebFetch (card-settings) — new unverified row for the admin setting that disables URL reading through an enterprise model gateway unless a proxy address is set
  • ADD featureControls.remoteControlEnabled (card-settings) — new unverified row for the admin setting letting an organization turn off Remote Control
  • CHG Ctrl+O (card-keys) — noted click-to-expand added in full screen (altscreen) mode for tool groups, thoughts, images, and multi-line command output
  • CHG agy acp [flags] (card-cli) — noted context window usage updates now sent to ACP editors on session start, model calls, and level changes
  • CHG --remote-agent (card-cli) — noted the first message of a conversation no longer waiting for its remote environment to start or resume
  • CHG GEMINI_API_KEY (card-env) — noted Gemini 4 Hydrogen (Low/Medium/High/XHigh) and Gemini 4 Carbon (Low/Medium/High) now available in /model and --model with this key
  • CHG AGY_ADC_AUTH (card-env) — noted Gemini 4 Hydrogen (Low/Medium/High/XHigh) now available under this sign-in method
  • CHG agy (card-cli) — noted Gemini 4 Hydrogen support through an enterprise model gateway, and web page reads now going directly from your machine instead of through Google's fetch service unless an admin disables it
  • FIX enableTerminalSandbox (card-settings) — fixed a security issue letting a command bypass path-based network rules with percent-encoded slashes, backslashes, or .. segments in a URL path
  • FIX /permissions (card-slash-core) — fixed "Always allow" command rules on Windows being bypassable via cmd/powershell.exe quoting differences
  • FIX /mcp (card-slash-tools) — fixed permission rules being ignored for eager-loaded MCP tools and the /browser subagent's Chrome DevTools tools
  • FIX /mcp (card-slash-tools) — fixed remote MCP servers that sign in with OAuth without a client secret signing you out when the access token expired
  • FIX /mcp (card-slash-tools) — fixed the agent telling you to click a Sign in button or Accounts tab instead of pointing to /plugin sign-in guidance
  • FIX /plugin (card-slash-tools) — fixed this, agy plugin, and headless -p runs ignoring an organization's Gemini Enterprise admin controls for plugins
  • FIX agy plugin <cmd> (card-cli) — same admin-controls fix, cited on this row
  • FIX -p / --print / --prompt (card-cli) — same admin-controls fix, cited on this row
  • FIX hooks.json (card-hooks) — fixed hook commands on Windows containing double quotes failing and being silently skipped, which could let a PreInvocation/PreToolUse hook go unenforced
  • FIX hooks.json (card-hooks) — fixed a file saved with a UTF-8 byte order mark leaving /hooks empty with none of its hooks running
  • FIX /agents (card-slash-tools) — fixed custom agent and rule files saved with a UTF-8 byte order mark going missing from here and the agent picker, or losing their frontmatter trigger
  • FIX Ctrl+G (card-keys) — fixed opening your external editor on Windows when EDITOR or editor is a normal Windows path, which also broke /open, /keybindings, and artifact review
  • FIX queuedMessages (card-settings) — fixed a single empty or corrupted queued message file blocking every later message to the agent
  • FIX /btw <query> (card-slash-tools) — fixed side questions, and /help's, failing with stream timed out after 5m0s while still working
  • FIX /help (card-slash-core) — same side-question timeout fix, cited on this row
  • FIX /learn [instruction] (card-slash-tools) — fixed this repeatedly appending to rule files until they grew past the documented size limit and silently lost their endings
  • FIX --json-schema <schema> (card-cli) — fixed follow-up turns in a conversation resumed with --conversation ending on plain text instead of structured output
  • FIX --conversation <id> (card-cli) — same structured-output regression fix, cited on this row
  • FIX /rewind / /undo (card-slash-core) — fixed this failing with a step_index out of bounds error after pressing Esc while a turn was still starting
  • FIX /diff (card-slash-tools) — fixed this showing a made-up change at the end of a diff for files larger than 500 KB when an earlier edit changed the file's length
  • FIX /artifact (card-slash-tools) — fixed / search here missing text split across different styles and leaving the rest of a line unstyled after a highlighted match
  • FIX /statusline (card-slash-core) — fixed status and error messages never appearing when using a custom status line

entry.title: Antigravity CLI v1.5.7 — 9 placemat changes
entry.content:
• CHG agentMode (card-settings) — noted sessions with no saved mode, including headless -p runs, now starting in auto wherever it is available and default elsewhere
  • CHG toolPermission (card-settings) — noted strict now taking precedence over auto and accept-edits modes, so file edits still ask for approval
  • FIX PreToolUse (card-hooks) — fixed a hook returning auto_approve, or a wildcard command(*) allow rule, bypassing an organization's admin-enforced review
  • FIX /permissions (card-slash-core) — fixed saved command allow and deny rules being ignored when an admin policy requires the terminal sandbox but the machine has no OS sandbox
  • FIX agy (card-cli) — fixed Gemini 4 Carbon requests through an enterprise model gateway failing with an HTTP 400 Thinking budget is not supported for this model error
  • FIX verbosity (card-settings) — fixed agent replies stalling 20 seconds or more while a group of tool calls with long output was still animating its token counts
  • FIX /tasks (card-slash-tools) — fixed the agent not noticing a backgrounded command was waiting for input, such as a password or y/n prompt
  • FIX /tasks (card-slash-tools) — fixed background task details from manage_task losing their formatting when output contained Markdown code blocks or runs of backticks
  • FIX /remote-control [on/off] (card-slash-tools) — fixed Remote Control showing a link that could not be opened, such as the swarm coordinator's link to the swarm UI

entry.title: Antigravity CLI v1.5.6 — 15 placemat changes
entry.content:
• CHG Stop (card-hooks) — noted a new continuation_active field in this hook's JSON input, true while the agent works on a continuation an earlier Stop hook requested
  • CHG /swarm board (card-slash-tools) — noted bee visuals added to the board header and Roster, with animated bee cards on Kitty-graphics terminals and pixel art elsewhere
  • CHG --mode <mode> (card-cli) — noted Auto mode's sandbox-escape review asking less often on safe reads such as GitHub API reads and single-file downloads, and no longer treating SSH config or public keys as secrets
  • CHG agy plugin <cmd> (card-cli) — noted validate now warning when a plugin hook command uses ${PLUGIN_ROOT} or $PLUGIN_ROOT, which older CLI versions do not set
  • CHG AGY_ADC_AUTH (card-env) — noted pay-as-you-go Google Cloud accounts signing in this way now using the same permission settings as other pay-as-you-go accounts, which makes Auto mode available
  • FIX agy (card-cli) — fixed some models served through an enterprise model gateway being sent requests without native tool declarations, which kept the agent from calling tools reliably
  • FIX agy (card-cli) — fixed custom Gemini models behind an enterprise model gateway or admin model list cutting off long edits and file writes at 8,192 output tokens
  • FIX agy plugin <cmd> (card-cli) — fixed install and import leaving a half-copied plugin that still loaded as enabled when an install failed partway
  • FIX agy plugin <cmd> (card-cli) — fixed install ignoring the skill folders a Claude Code plugin lists in the "skills" field of its manifest
  • FIX enableTerminalSandbox (card-settings) — fixed duplicate approval prompts and sandbox errors for organizations enforcing sandbox mode on machines without an OS sandbox
  • FIX /permissions (card-slash-core) — fixed editing project rules here clearing the marker that records the project's permission rules as already migrated
  • FIX /swarm <task> (card-slash-tools) — fixed the coordinator ending a turn with a one-line filler reply after being sent back to re-read board posts it had already read
  • FIX /swarm <task> (card-slash-tools) — fixed the coordinator offering a sidecar:// board link the CLI cannot open, and agy -p runs pointing to /swarm board, which headless runs cannot open
  • FIX /swarm board (card-slash-tools) — fixed Esc in a member's conversation opened with o dropping back to the prompt instead of returning to the board
  • FIX Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Shift+Z (card-keys) — fixed undo and redo, including u in Vim mode, moving the cursor to the end of the input

entry.title: Antigravity CLI v1.5.5 — 13 placemat changes
entry.content:
• ADD /swarm <task> (card-slash-tools) — new preview command that starts a swarm of worker agents coordinating on a shared message board
  • ADD /swarm board (card-slash-tools) — new full-screen live view of the current swarm, also opened with Alt+S
  • ADD Alt+S (card-keys) — new keybinding that opens /swarm board (swarm.board)
  • ADD Alt+X (card-keys) — new keybinding that dismisses a finished swarm's status row (swarm.dismiss)
  • ADD ANTIGRAVITY_DISABLE_EMBEDDED_RIPGREP (card-env) — new env var that stops the CLI from extracting and running its bundled ripgrep
  • CHG AGY_ADC_AUTH (card-env) — noted Gemini 4 Carbon (Low, Medium, High) now available in /model and --model under this sign-in method
  • CHG agy (card-cli) — noted enterprise model gateway URLs now required to use https:// unless the gateway runs on the same machine
  • FIX agy (card-cli) — fixed enterprise model gateways that validate request format rejecting every request over a non-standard sessionId field
  • FIX agy plugin <cmd> (card-cli) — fixed import turning Claude Code plugin commands into skills that did not load or were all named SKILL
  • FIX agy plugin <cmd> (card-cli) — fixed import copying some plugins' hooks/hooks.json unchanged, which skipped the plugin's hooks
  • FIX -p / --print / --prompt (card-cli) — fixed headless runs sometimes never exiting after printing their result when a background task got stuck
  • FIX /teamwork / /teamwork-preview (card-slash-tools) — fixed two runs in the same workspace sharing .agents/teamwork/ and overwriting each other's run state
  • FIX /agents (card-slash-tools) — fixed subagents and swarm workers losing uncommitted work when given their own copy of a Git repository

entry.title: Antigravity CLI v1.5.4 — 10 placemat changes
entry.content:
• CHG agy acp [flags] (card-cli) — noted Auto mode support added for ACP editor sessions
  • CHG hooks.json (card-hooks) — noted hookEventName, cwd, and toolCall.id added to the JSON input hooks receive
  • CHG --mode <mode> (card-cli) — noted Auto mode's sandbox-escape review now uses a lighter-thinking Gemini Flash model to decide faster
  • FIX agy acp [flags] (card-cli) — fixed sessions dropping back to the default mode when an editor reloaded or resumed an open session
  • FIX agy acp [flags] (card-cli) — fixed turns hanging when a tool call needed a second permission approval
  • FIX /agents (card-slash-tools) — fixed crashes and freezes with subagents in narrow terminals and while answering their questions
  • FIX PgUp / PgDn (card-keys) — fixed paging skipping text at message boundaries and under the pinned prompt header in full-screen mode
  • FIX Ctrl+O (card-keys) — fixed a thought indented as if part of the tool call it follows in the expanded view
  • FIX agy remote-control (card-cli) — fixed the background service staying disconnected for good when it started before the network was up
  • FIX --remote-agent (card-cli) — fixed the Sign-in update needed warning not appearing in these sessions

entry.title: Antigravity CLI v1.5.3 — 13 placemat changes
entry.content:
• CHG /agents (card-slash-tools) — noted each subagent's model now shown next to its name, with a single Tip: Press enter on a subagent to view details. line instead of repeating [view details]
  • CHG /statusline (card-slash-core) — noted a new model field on each subagents entry in the status line JSON
  • CHG hooks.json (card-hooks) — noted PLUGIN_ROOT and PLUGIN_DATA environment variables now added to hook commands that come from a plugin
  • CHG /plugin / /plugins (card-slash-tools) — noted plugin sign-in screen formatting improvements and the plugin's display name now used instead of its slug
  • FIX agy plugin <cmd> (card-cli) — fixed uninstall, enable, disable, and list failing for symlinked plugins or names containing spaces or symbols such as c++-tools
  • FIX agy (card-cli) — fixed agent turns failing with an http2: timeout awaiting response headers error, which are now retried, and a 404 when an enterprise model gateway URL ended in /v1beta
  • FIX /plugin / /plugins (card-slash-tools) — fixed the agent's requests to sign in to a plugin being dropped from the conversation
  • FIX queuedMessages (card-settings) — fixed a message sent in Send Immediately mode briefly disappearing from the conversation when it arrived just as the turn ended
  • FIX hooks.json (card-hooks) — fixed hooks receiving a placeholder or empty model name when the session uses a custom model
  • FIX --remote-agent (card-cli) — fixed files larger than the remote read limit being silently cut off, now loading in full up to 20 MiB
  • FIX agy acp [flags] (card-cli) — fixed these sessions exiting before the agent backend finished shutting down, which could interrupt saving conversation data
  • FIX enableTerminalSandbox (card-settings) — fixed a security issue where a sandboxed command could change environment state loaded by persistent terminal commands run outside the sandbox, and hardened persistent terminal IDs against path traversal
  • FIX /context (card-slash-tools) — fixed paths sharing a prefix with your home directory showing a mangled ~ prefix here and in the keybindings reset hint

entry.title: Antigravity CLI v1.5.2 — 16 placemat changes
entry.content:
• ADD AGY_CLI_MAC_OPTION_AS_ALT (card-env) — new env var that restores the pre-1.5.2 behavior where macOS Option-key shortcuts need terminal setup; unverified, named only in the release notes
  • CHG /skills (card-slash-tools) — noted cloud plugin skills now reaching --remote-agent sessions, grouped under Remote agent skills
  • CHG Alt+M (card-keys) — noted macOS Option-key shortcuts now work out of the box without terminal configuration
  • CHG --dangerously-skip-permissions (card-cli) — noted protected commands and Gemini Enterprise admin review requirements are no longer bypassed by this flag or auto-allow plugin agents
  • CHG allowNonWorkspaceAccess (card-settings) — noted the outside-workspace file-access prompt reworded to scope an allow/deny to a single path instead of turning this setting on globally
  • CHG -p / --print / --prompt (card-cli) — noted these runs no longer make a background model request to generate a conversation title print mode never shows
  • CHG /remote-control [on/off] (card-slash-tools) — noted Remote Control connections now retry a brief network or server error instead of dropping it
  • CHG agy plugin <cmd> (card-cli) — noted hardening against malicious plugins: unsafe plugin names are rejected, and writes outside the plugins folder or through symbolic links are refused
  • CHG .agents/skills/<name>/SKILL.md (card-skills) — noted workspace .agents/plugins.json and .agents/skills.json entries now restricted to the workspace or repository root
  • FIX --dangerously-skip-permissions (card-cli) — fixed subagents stalling about 60 seconds on file permissions; reads and writes outside the workspace now go through without a prompt
  • FIX /mcp (card-slash-tools) — fixed OAuth sign-in failing with Invalid PKCE code_verifier when the server reconnected during sign-in
  • FIX mcp_config.json (card-hooks) — fixed MCP tools declaring their own explanation, toolSummary, toolAction, or waitForPreviousTools parameter not receiving that argument
  • FIX queuedMessages (card-settings) — fixed the agent re-running a failed turn in a rapid loop when messages were queued at the moment it hit an error
  • FIX agy acp [flags] (card-cli) — fixed the / menu listing a default agent's commands instead of the session's actual agent
  • FIX /projects (card-slash-tools) — fixed adding PDFs, other binary files, or files larger than about 8 MB to a remote project, which now upload successfully
  • FIX /voice / /record (card-slash-tools) — fixed voice dictation in Chinese and Japanese showing a space between every character in the live draft

entry.title: Antigravity CLI v1.5.1 — 10 placemat changes
entry.content:
• CHG agy acp [flags] (card-cli) — noted every model available to your account now offered to every ACP client, where previously only a fixed list of editors were offered models other than Gemini
  • CHG /config / /settings (card-slash-core) — noted the Local/Remote tabs renamed to TUI/Remote Agent during --remote-agent sessions
  • CHG /tasks (card-slash-tools) — noted the agent now moving on within about 1 second, instead of 5, after a terminal command exits while a background process it started still holds the output open
  • CHG /agents (card-slash-tools) — noted blocked subagent rows now naming the tool they are waiting on, such as Blocked · AskQuestion
  • CHG --sandbox (card-cli) — noted plugin OAuth credentials now protected per-header, so a sandboxed command can no longer get a site to echo a real token back from another header or the URL
  • FIX agy acp [flags] (card-cli) — fixed several session bugs: closing, reloading, or resuming a session mid-prompt now ends it as cancelled instead of hanging, cancelling a prompt no longer also stops the next one, and permission/question forms now close when answered elsewhere
  • FIX /mcp (card-slash-tools) — fixed stdio MCP servers on Windows leaving child processes running after the server stops, which could lock plugin folders and fail plugin upgrades
  • FIX agy plugin <cmd> (card-cli) — fixed these commands being unavailable, with no marketplaces listed, when signed in with Application Default Credentials (AGY_ADC_AUTH) or an enterprise model gateway
  • FIX /browser <task> (card-slash-tools) — fixed the built-in browser agent being listed among the agents you can start a conversation with; it still runs only as a subagent
  • FIX /copy [n|btw] (card-slash-tools) — fixed copy-on-select and this command inside GNU screen, so copied text reaches the clipboard and long selections no longer leave stray characters

entry.title: Antigravity CLI v1.5.0 — 14 placemat changes
entry.content:
• ADD agy acp [flags] (card-cli) — new subcommand that runs the CLI as an Agent Client Protocol server for editors such as Zed, JetBrains IDEs, Android Studio, and Xcode
  • ADD --remote-agent (card-cli) — new flag that runs the session's conversations on Remote Agents instead of this machine
  • ADD /projects (card-slash-tools) — new slash command to list, create, rename, and switch between local projects; unverified, absent from the current cli/reference core slash command table
  • CHG /plugin / /plugins (card-slash-tools) — noted a new sign-in flow for a partner plugin's MCP servers, with a Connect <plugin> screen and a ⚠ needs sign-in marker
  • CHG --print-timeout <dur> (card-cli) — noted headless runs without this flag now waiting for background tasks to finish instead of stopping them after a hidden 30-minute limit; a timeout now exits with code 3 and an AGY_ERROR line
  • CHG /btw <query> (card-slash-tools) — noted side questions can now call tools, shown live with a Called N tools summary
  • CHG altScreenMode (card-settings) — noted the always option's /config label renamed from no flickering (altscreen) to full screen (altscreen); the saved setting is unchanged
  • CHG /mcp (card-slash-tools) — noted a clearer error for a stdio server command that isn't installed, naming the command instead of a raw executable file not found error
  • CHG --mode <mode> (card-cli) — noted Auto mode's sandbox-escape review timing out and asking less often on more safe commands
  • FIX /diff (card-slash-tools) — fixed an empty ↕ ··· fold divider drawn at the top of new files and of edits starting at line 1, where nothing was folded away
  • FIX Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Shift+Z (card-keys) — fixed undo in the main prompt bringing back an already-sent message, and undo in ! shell or : search mode bringing back text Enter would then run
  • FIX GEMINI_API_KEY (card-env) — fixed conversations re-sending a prompt forever when the safety filter blocks it, and fixed the pro/flash subagents on this connection running models two generations older than intended
  • FIX agy (card-cli) — fixed certain models failing a turn on rate-limit or server errors instead of retrying, now honoring the server's Retry-After header
  • FIX agy plugin <cmd> (card-cli) — fixed auto-upgrades of a renamed plugin writing to a new folder and retrying on every startup instead of updating the existing folder in place

entry.title: Antigravity CLI v1.4.12 — 1 placemat change
entry.content: • ADD plugins/<name>/auth.json (card-hooks) — a plugin's API key entries can mark a key "optional": true, so unset keys for services with a free tier make unauthenticated requests at the limited rate instead of failing with a 401 error or a sign-in prompt

entry.title: Antigravity CLI v1.4.11 — 4 placemat changes
entry.content:
• CHG PreInvocation (card-hooks) — noted a new terminationBehavior field: returning "terminate" stops the turn before the model is called, and an errorMessage can carry a userMessage back to you without reaching the model
  • CHG --output-format <fmt> (card-cli) — noted a new finished_reason field on json/stream-json results explaining why a turn ended early
  • CHG /plugin / /plugins (card-slash-tools) — noted the Discover tab's long shelves now showing their first 6 plugins with an expand/collapse control and [/] shelf navigation
  • FIX agy plugin import claude (card-hooks) — fixed this failing to find plugins installed from a Claude Code marketplace, and fixed imported plugins losing their remote MCP servers and .mcp.json-sourced servers

entry.title: Antigravity CLI v1.4.10 — 4 placemat changes
entry.content:
• FIX /agents (card-slash-tools) — fixed subagents losing the task their parent agent gave them, and the parent's ID, after their context was compacted; a subagent's summary now keeps the parent's 10 most recent messages
  • CHG /context (card-slash-core) — noted the after-compaction size shown here and in the compaction marker now also counting what the summary carries into the next prompt, so it is closer to the real size
  • FIX /artifact (card-slash-tools) — capped attached images at 2000 pixels per side and converted large PNGs to JPEG to stop requests being rejected for exceeding the model's size limit, and fixed an image saved as JPEG but labeled PNG being rejected for a mismatched type
  • FIX /browser <task> (card-slash-tools) — fixed this subagent not receiving a page's snapshot when the selected page belongs to an isolated browser context, such as one opened with isolatedContext

entry.title: Antigravity CLI v1.4.9 — 10 placemat changes
entry.content:
• ADD Ctrl+V (card-keys) — added native terminal paste shortcut and drag-and-drop image attachment, including over SSH with X11 or Wayland forwarding
  • CHG /plugin / /plugins (card-slash-tools) — noted the Discover tab now grouping marketplace plugins into sections instead of one flat list
  • CHG agy plugin <cmd> (card-cli) — noted validate warning on non-kebab-case plugin names and checking a plugin's logo and context provider iconUri paths
  • CHG /diff (card-slash-tools) — noted the position indicator under long lists now saying what it counts, such as [1-44 of 195 files]
  • CHG --mode <mode> (card-cli) — noted the sandbox-escape review now skipping git status in folders that aren't repositories
  • CHG /permissions (card-slash-core) — noted execute_url approvals now per-origin for sensitive Google apps such as mail.google.com, instead of being covered by approving a general Google site
  • FIX /permissions (card-slash-core) — fixed "Always allow" rules for multi-line commands, such as a python -c script spanning several lines, never taking effect
  • FIX editorMode (card-settings) — fixed Vim mode's r, f, F, t, and T canceling when the target character is a space, and a half-typed operator carrying over after submitting a prompt
  • FIX /artifact (card-slash-tools) — fixed conversations failing every later model request with INVALID_MEDIA after the agent viewed a corrupt or malformed image
  • FIX /browser <task> (card-slash-tools) — fixed this subagent not receiving the current page's snapshot with Chrome DevTools MCP 1.11 and later

entry.title: Antigravity CLI v1.4.8 — 6 placemat changes
entry.content:
• ADD /diff (card-slash-tools) — added [/] turn-jump shortcuts in Per Turn, progressive background loading for large repositories and long conversations, and sized listings for large or binary untracked files
  • CHG --mode <mode> (card-cli) — noted the sandbox-escape review getting more time to decide and stopping any single slow check after 10 seconds
  • CHG agy plugin <cmd> (card-cli) — noted expanded install output naming every installed component, and validate checking a plugin's author, homepage, and repository fields
  • CHG /resume / /switch / /conversation (card-slash-core) — noted resuming a conversation now using about 10% less CPU
  • FIX /agents (card-slash-tools) — fixed subagents failing to run when their custom agent's name contains a colon, and fixed deleting a conversation leaving its running subagents and workspaces behind instead of cleaning them up
  • FIX Ctrl+V (card-keys) — fixed pasting images on Windows when copied from a browser, Snipping Tool, or another app that puts PNG or V5 bitmap data on the clipboard

entry.title: Antigravity CLI v1.4.7 — 8 placemat changes
entry.content:
• ADD hooks.json (card-hooks) — added lastUserInput to the JSON that hook commands receive on stdin
  • CHG /help (card-slash-core) — noted the shortcuts tab leaving out basic navigation keys so the more useful shortcuts are easier to find
  • CHG /mcp (card-slash-tools) — noted on-demand MCP tools now returning inline results up to 10 KB, previously 4 KB
  • CHG --mode <mode> (card-cli) — noted Auto mode asking for approval less often on routine commands such as cleanup and formatting
  • CHG colorScheme (card-settings) — noted the default Terminal scheme now using box-drawing table borders in Markdown, matching the other color schemes
  • FIX /compact [message] (card-slash-core) — fixed conversations compacting over and over when a single message, tool output, or attached document was too large to fit in the context
  • FIX editorMode (card-settings) — fixed Vim mode's r replace leaving part of a collapsed pasted-text placeholder behind
  • FIX /mcp (card-slash-tools) — fixed plugin and MCP sign-ins not saving when the token was too large for the system keychain, and an OAuth token being shared across or left behind for different users of the same computer account

entry.title: Antigravity CLI v1.4.6 — 6 placemat changes
entry.content:
• ADD /plugin / /plugins (card-slash-tools) — added a Configure MCP servers... action for installed plugins to set or change MCP server variables without disabling and re-enabling the plugin
  • CHG --sandbox (card-cli) — noted sandboxed commands can no longer read or modify ~/.docker, ~/.kube, or ~/_netrc without an explicit grant
  • CHG /compact [message] (card-slash-core) — noted compaction now keeping images, PDFs, and other attached files in the conversation summary
  • CHG /statusline (card-slash-core) — noted the in-progress status line now showing what the agent is waiting on, such as a retrying model, instead of a generic working label
  • CHG agy plugin <cmd> (card-cli) — noted validate expanded to check a plugin's context providers and skills entries in plugin.json
  • FIX Esc (card-keys) — fixed the Esc disabled during file edits warning naming the wrong reject key when the prompt shows an extra choice

entry.title: Antigravity CLI v1.4.5 — 4 placemat changes
entry.content:
• CHG Ctrl+O (card-keys) — noted collapsed thought blocks now showing only their Thought for … header, separated from the response by a blank line
  • CHG /schedule <when> <task> (card-slash-tools) — noted recurring schedules now firing at a consistent per-schedule offset instead of exactly on the cron boundary
  • CHG /diff (card-slash-tools) — noted folded-line match counts in / search, a consistent cursor style in Commit Tree, and Per Turn starting on the first file
  • FIX /plugin / /plugins (card-slash-tools) — fixed plugins failing to load when plugin.json gives skills as a single path string instead of an array, and marketplace installs failing on a briefly stale or interrupted download

entry.title: Antigravity CLI v1.4.4 — 14 placemat changes
entry.content:
• CHG --mode <mode> (card-cli) — noted Auto mode now available on Windows 11 24H2+ for personal Google Accounts, and its sandbox-escape review getting faster, considering the preceding question on short replies like yes, checking every subcommand in a pipeline, and prompting before destructive Git or file commands
  • CHG Shift+Tab (card-keys) — noted it now also cycles into Auto mode on Windows 11 24H2+, matching --mode auto
  • CHG /diff (card-slash-tools) — noted the whole-file toggle (f) and hunk folding (Ctrl+O) extended to the Commit Tree view, Per Turn diffs combining multiple edits to one file, and the fix for long rows wrapping instead of truncating and Per Turn headers truncating prompts at 50 characters
  • CHG mcp_config.json (card-hooks) — noted _meta["antigravity.google/root_conversation_id"] now sent on MCP tools/call requests so servers see the top-level conversation ID from nested subagents
  • CHG agy plugin <cmd> (card-cli) — noted validate getting stricter checks across plugin.json, MCP configs, hooks.json, and sidecar manifests for invalid JSON, unknown fields, bad placeholders, unrecognized hook matchers, and missing hook scripts
  • CHG /compact [message] (card-slash-core) — noted automatic and on-demand compaction now keeping tool declarations so the model API can reuse its cached prompt prefix
  • CHG agy remote-control (card-cli) — noted the multi-pane touch layout for tablets/foldables, scrollbar popovers staying open while dragged, and fixes for clipped phone dialogs, iOS Safari input zoom, reverting telemetry/marketing settings, dropped drag-URL query parameters, broken nested code blocks, $VAR parsed as LaTeX, blurry Copy Image/Export as PDF, and background-tab timer drift
  • FIX /agents (card-slash-tools) — noted the fix for subagents losing plugins inherited from the parent session, and plugin-bundled subagents with restricted MCP tools failing to start
  • FIX .agents/skills/<name>/SKILL.md (card-skills) — noted the fix for rules and skills loading twice when found in both a standalone folder and an enabled plugin
  • FIX verbosity (card-settings) — noted the fix for the prompt box staying mid-screen after closing panels, and blank gaps above the prompt in Medium verbosity
  • FIX Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Shift+Z (card-keys) — noted the fix for mishandled pasted text, merged history entries, no-op undo steps, and characters truncated near emoji
  • FIX /mcp (card-slash-tools) — noted the fix for MCP client sessions and background connection routines leaking on a failed tools/list or shutdown mid-connect
  • FIX ~/.gemini/GEMINI.md (card-skills) — noted the system-prompt wording fix so GEMINI.md/AGENTS.md rules explicitly override earlier built-in instructions too, not just later ones
  • FIX Ctrl+V (card-keys) — noted the fix for parameterized MIME types such as audio/webm; codecs=opus being rejected as unsupported

entry.title: Antigravity CLI v1.4.3 — 11 placemat changes
entry.content:
• ADD /diff (card-slash-tools) — noted the new / search across the file list and file view, with match highlighting, a match-count prompt, and n/N stepping through matches
  • CHG /artifact (card-slash-tools) — noted n/N in this viewer now also stepping through matches one at a time, including several on the same line
  • CHG agy plugin <cmd> (card-cli) — noted validate expanded to check a plugin's hooks, sidecars, and component manifests, and install/import now following NO_COLOR/CLICOLOR/CLICOLOR_FORCE like validate already did
  • CHG /tasks (card-slash-tools) — noted timer durations now shown in human-readable units, such as 1d 2h timer, instead of raw seconds
  • CHG --mode <mode> (card-cli) — noted subagents and custom agents in Auto mode no longer asking approval for every sandbox-escaping command; a separate agent reviews them like the main agent's
  • CHG enableTerminalSandbox (card-settings) — noted the CLI no longer offering sandboxed options on systems where the sandbox can't run, such as Linux systems blocking unprivileged user namespaces and Windows before 11 24H2
  • FIX GEMINI_API_KEY (card-env) — noted the fix for Gemini 4 Argon not appearing in /model and --model when connected with this key
  • FIX /agents (card-slash-tools) — noted the fix for the agent losing track of its most recently started subagents after a conversation was compacted
  • FIX PostToolUse (card-hooks) — noted a failing hook no longer marking a successful tool call as failed; the failure is now logged separately
  • FIX /plugin / /plugins (card-slash-tools) — noted the fix for updating or reinstalling a marketplace plugin on Windows leaving it half-deleted while another session or app had it open
  • FIX agy remote-control (card-cli) — noted Remote Control on iPhone/iPad no longer re-prompting the Security Notice and Enable Notifications dialogs every time; it now remembers those answers along with theme, layout, and dismissed tips
